title: feat(metadata-protocol, spec, lint)!: a post-publish probe finding carries the sentence for the person who published, in their language
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X4KthxjbE68SmtZYZQBCfuQ)_

Part of #32984

This is the framework half of Q1, under ruling record 6929121584 on the card. Three parts of the card stay open after this merges: the console read of `userMessage` in `ui/packages/plugin-chatbot` (#34539), Q2 (the label of a field that a change will create: ruled B in record 6929142905, not built here; its cloud card is #34468 and its spec card #34469), and the cloud half of Q1 (the graph lint's findings, parked under the same ruling as #34467).

Clause-②: yes (narrowing) — narrowed: `PublishPackageDraftsResponseSchema.probes` FROM `z.unknown()` (any value parses; input and output type `unknown`) → TO `BuildProbeReportSchema` (only the report parses; type `BuildProbeReport`). Widened: the optional `RuntimeBuildIssue.userMessage`, the new `RuntimeBuildIssueSchema` / `BuildProbeReportSchema` exports, and `userTextLocaleOf` / `renderUserText` / `UserTextEntry` from `@objectstack/lint`.
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: follow-up #34552

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：发布之后的运行检查（ADR-0038 L3 探针）给每条发现多带一句 `userMessage`，是写给发布者本人看的话。语言按请求来定：请求语言，否则工作区默认语言，否则英文；覆盖平台 11 种语言和全部 8 个探针代码。句子里用标签称呼仪表盘、组件、数据集、视图和对象，读不到标签时才用 API 名；发布账号被拒绝读取的对象例外，按拒绝里的 API 名称呼，探针不去读它的标签。`probes` 在 spec 里由 `z.unknown()` 改为有模型的 `BuildProbeReportSchema`，这是一次申报过的收窄（`Clause-②: yes (narrowing)`），ADR-0038 追加一节修订。
- **为什么改**：构建健康卡把写给 agent 的英文 `message` 直接给客户看，客户看不懂，也不知道下一步做什么（卡片第 4 项）。裁决记录 6929121584 定为「出问题的一方写客户句」，客户端不再各自维护一张按代码翻译的表。
- **风险与回滚**：`message`、`fix`、`code` 逐字节不变，现有读取方不受影响；`userMessage` 是新增的可选字段。唯一变严的地方，已按收窄申报：`probes` 不再接受不是报告形状的值。平台自己的生产者只产出这一种形状（两套一致性测试对真实生产者实测），受影响的只会是手写这个响应的代码（别的协议宿主、测试替身），TypeScript 编译器会在调用处指出来；changeset 带 BREAKING 说明和改法。回滚就是 revert 本 PR；在控制台的第二个 PR 合并之前，界面仍显示 `message`。
- **先看**：① `packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts` 里的 `RuntimeBuildIssueSchema`、`BuildProbeReportSchema` 和 `probes:` 那一行（契约形状，风险最高）；② `packages/metadata-protocol/src/build-probes.user-text.ts`（11 种语言的句子，值得请母语读者抽看措辞）；③ `packages/metadata-protocol/src/build-probes.ts` 里每个 `issues.push` 新增的 `userMessage: say(...)`，以及取标签的 `labelIn` / `labelOf`。
- **两分钟验证**：运行 `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/build-probes-user-message.test.ts`，预期全部通过；用例对中文句子做逐字断言，例如「仪表盘“团队看板”中的组件“未完成任务”没有显示任何数据，但“Tasks”中有记录。」
- **需要你做的**：一个动作：批准这次申报的收窄（`probes` 从此只接受报告形状的值，见 Acceptance notes 第 5 条）。本 PR 触及 `docs/adr/**` 和 `packages/spec/src/**`，是 Tier H；契约评审记录由席位送审。

## What changes

**`@objectstack/spec` (`packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts`).** `probes` on `PublishPackageDraftsResponseSchema` is modeled. It was `z.unknown()`; it is now `BuildProbeReportSchema`: `issues[]` of `RuntimeBuildIssueSchema`, and `checked` with the `seeds`, `views`, `widgets` and `objects` counts. `RuntimeBuildIssueSchema` declares `layer`, `severity`, `artifact`, `ref` (optional), `code`, `message`, `fix` (optional) and the new optional `userMessage`. These are the members the probe pass already wrote, one for one, plus the new field. `code` stays an open string, because the producer's list may grow and a consumer treats an unknown id as any other finding. The notes that called `probes` "deliberately opaque" (the #9406 staging) now say which consumer reads which fields. The two types `RuntimeBuildIssue` and `BuildProbeReport` are declared once, in spec.

**`@objectstack/metadata-protocol`.**

- `build-probes.ts`: every finding the probes emit carries `userMessage`. `message`, `fix` and `code` are byte-identical to before. `RunBuildProbesOptions` gains `userTextLocales`; the local `RuntimeBuildIssue` and `BuildProbeReport` interfaces are replaced by re-exports of the spec types, so the producer and the declared response cannot drift apart.
- `build-probes.user-text.ts` (new): the sentence catalog. Eight codes, every branch of each, in the eleven platform locales (`en`, `zh-Hans`, `zh-Hant`, `es`, `ar`, `fr`, `pt-BR`, `ru`, `de`, `ja`, `ko`).
- `protocol-history-and-publish.ts`: `publishPackageDrafts` hands the `request.userTextLocales` it already holds to `runBuildProbes`. No request parameter is added.

**`@objectstack/lint`.** `userTextLocaleOf` and `renderUserText`, the locale ladder behind `findingUserMessage`, are exported from the package root and from `@objectstack/lint/runtime`, with the `UserTextEntry` type. The probes use that ladder instead of a second copy.

**ADR-0038.** A dated amendment, "two readers, two channels", appended at the end: `message` and `fix` are the agent's text, `userMessage` is the person's sentence, the producer writes it under the locale ladder, and clients keep no per-code table. It cites ruling records 6819749037 and 6929121584.

**Generated by their tools, not by hand.** `packages/spec/{api-surface,authorable-surface,declaration-map,export-origins,json-schema.manifest}/api.json`, `content/docs/references/api/protocol.mdx`, `content/docs/references/index.mdx` and `docs/audits/2026-07-unknown-key-strictness-ledger.counts/api.md`, all written by `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:generated --fix` after a spec build.

**Comment-only edits that the change made false.** `packages/client/src/index.ts` (the docblock of the publish-drafts answer), `packages/runtime/src/route-ledger.ts` (a note string, in a module that is not bundled into the runtime's built output) and `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` (a docblock, with a zero-line delta against the facade line ceiling).

Nothing under `ui/**` is touched. The console keeps rendering `message` until the second pull request reads `userMessage`.

### What the person reads, per code

A sentence names an artifact by its label where the probe can read one from the published item, and by its API name otherwise.

| code | names shown | English sentence (labels: dashboard "Task board", widget "Open tasks", dataset "Task totals", object "Tasks", view "All tasks") |
|---|---|---|
| `seed_not_applied` | the seeded object's label (a seed has no label) | The sample data for "Tasks" did not load, so "Tasks" has no records yet. Check the sample data, then publish again. |
| `view_read_failed` | view label, object label | The view "All tasks" cannot read "Tasks", so it shows an error instead of records. Make sure "Tasks" is published, then publish again. |
| `object_field_ref_unknown` | object label | One of the settings of "Tasks" names a field that does not exist or cannot be used there, so that setting does not work. Correct the field it names, then publish again. |
| `object_field_ref_rule_failed` | object label | "Tasks" was published, but its field settings could not be checked. The problem is in the check itself, not necessarily in "Tasks"; contact your administrator if it happens again. |
| `widget_not_probed` | dashboard label, widget title; the dataset by its API name | The widget "Open tasks" on dashboard "Task board" was not checked: more than one dataset is named "crm_task_totals", so the dashboard cannot tell which one it means. Rename or remove the others, then publish again. |
| `empty_query` | dashboard, widget, dataset and object, all by label | The widget "Open tasks" on dashboard "Task board" shows no data, although "Tasks" has records. Check the fields that its dataset "Task totals" measures and groups by, then publish again. |
| `widget_query_failed` | dashboard, widget and dataset by label; the object by label for a query that fails, and by the API name the refusal names for a refusal or an undecided read (nothing of that object is read); no object when the refusal names none | The widget "Open tasks" on dashboard "Task board" could not load its data: the account that published it does not have read access to "crm_task". Ask an administrator for that access, then publish again. People who already have it can see the widget. |
| `probes_unavailable` | no name: one finding covers every dashboard of the publish | Dashboard widgets were not checked (3 in total), because analytics is not available in this environment. Open each published dashboard to see whether its widgets load. |

`widget_not_probed` names its dataset by API name on purpose: the read of that dataset was refused, so there is no body to take a label from, and the name is the subject of the sentence (two datasets share it). `seed_not_applied`, `widget_not_probed` and `widget_query_failed` have more than one branch; the table shows one of each.

## Tests

- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/build-probes-user-message.test.ts` (new). Fourteen real probe runs, one per code and branch, over published items with labels. For each run and each of the eleven locales: `userMessage` equals the catalog sentence for the expected params, the labels appear, the API names of labelled artifacts do not, `message` and `fix` are unchanged, and the finding and the report parse through the spec schemas with nothing stripped. It also pins the ladder (request locale over workspace default, default when the request names none, an unknown locale falling through, the `en` floor, regional tags such as `de-AT`, `zh-TW` and `zh-Hant-HK`), the label fallbacks (no label, blank label, unreadable body, a read that throws), and the catalog itself: its keys are the codes scanned from `build-probes.ts`, every code is exercised, and every entry answers in every platform locale.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/build-probes-rule-failure.test.ts`: the rule-failure finding carries the English and the Chinese sentence, and neither contains the thrown text.
- `packages/spec/src/api/protocol.test.ts`: the report and the finding schemas accept what the producer emits, keep `userMessage`, accept a code that a later probe adds, and reject a `probes` value that is not the report. `packages/spec/src/type-alias-convention.pin.test.ts` counts the two new type aliases.
- `packages/objectql/src/publish-package-drafts-response-conformance.test.ts` and `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages-publish-drafts-response-conformance.test.ts`: the real producer's response parses through the modeled schema and equals the raw answer ("declared = returned").
- `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages-publish-drafts-probe-caller-context.test.ts`: through the real REST door, a `zh-CN` caller reads the Chinese sentence with labels, a caller with no locale in a `fr-FR` workspace reads the French one, a caller with neither reads English, and a clean publish has no findings (control).

## Acceptance notes

The dispatch order's mechanism assumptions, as measured on the tree:

1. **Locales reach the probe without a new request parameter: holds.** `publishPackageDrafts` holds `request.userTextLocales`; the REST door fills it from the caller's locale and the workspace default (`packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts`). The probe options gained `userTextLocales`, and that is the whole hand-off.
2. **Reuse the lint ladder: holds, with one addition.** `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` already depends on `@objectstack/lint`, so the direction is legal. The ladder was module-internal to lint, so this pull request exports `userTextLocaleOf` and `renderUserText` from lint's two barrels. That widens lint's published surface by two functions and one type, and puts lint in the changeset. Rollback of that part is dropping the two export lines.
3. **"11 platform locales": holds.** `PLATFORM_LOCALE_TAGS` in `@objectstack/spec/system` has eleven tags, and the catalog pin requires each entry to answer in exactly that set.
4. **Labels through `publishedItemReader`: holds, per code as in the table above.** A label is the published body's own `label` (a widget's `title`), resolved for the sentence's locale when it is a per-locale map. Translation bundles are not consulted: an app that keeps its labels only in a translation bundle shows the body's label, or the API name when the body has none.
5. **A declared narrowing (contract review 6933939654, M1).** The model is one for one what `runBuildProbes` emits, and the schema is not strict, so an extra key is not rejected; the two conformance suites parse the real producer's answer and require it to equal the raw answer. But a `probes` value that is not the report (a string, a different object, a finding missing a member) no longer parses, where `z.unknown()` accepted anything, and the `z.input` type `PublishPackageDraftsResponse` moves from `unknown` to the report for code that writes it. The repository reads that as a narrowing with zero measured instances (ADR-0087's reading of a surface moving off `unknown`), so the PR body and the changeset declare `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)` with the FROM → TO line, the changeset carries the BREAKING note with its fix, and its ADR-0087 disposition is `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`: `probes` is a response field the platform writes, so nothing exists for `objectstack migrate meta` to rewrite. `type-surface-only` does not apply (the diff touches `packages/spec`). The full dogfood battery ran on the final head (Verification).
6. **`Metadata-protocol: added` (corrected by the seat from `none`).** `check:authorable-surface` is green and `authorable-surface.base.json` did not move, but `packages/spec/authorable-surface/api.json` gained ten keys (the keys of the two response schemas), and the changeset ratchet reads a moved shard as keys entered; the changeset says `added` with spec at minor. The probe writes these keys; no metadata author does.

7. **An object the caller was refused is named as its refusal names it (contract review 6933939654, S1).** After a read-admission refusal (`access`, `field-access`) or a read gate that could not decide (`unavailable`), the sentence names the object by the API name the refusal carries, exactly as `fix` names it, and the probe reads nothing of that object, its label included. Only a query that failed for another reason reads the dataset's object for its label. Pinned in `build-probes-user-message.test.ts` (zero object reads for the three failures, with the query failure as the control) and through the REST door.

Other notes:

- The ADR amendment is 24 lines, a little over the "about 10 to 20" the order suggested.
- The file surface is wider than the order's scope list by the lint barrels, the two conformance suites, the runtime door test, and the three comment-only edits listed under "What changes".
- `origin/main` was merged into the branch once (`scripts/pm/os-regen-merge.sh`), because the generated reference index moved on `main`.
- The publish toasts outside the health line (publish-all-drafts and `PendingDraftsBar`) print `issues[].message` verbatim: filed #34553.
- `message` builds its widget id as `String(w.id ?? w.title ?? '?')`, which would print `[object Object]` for a widget with no `id` and a per-locale `title` map: not a defect reachable today, because the dashboard schema requires a widget `id`. `ref.member` now says what the producer writes.
- `publishedItemReader` returns `wrapper?.item ?? wrapper`, and the real `getMetaItem` answers a missing item with an envelope whose `item` is empty, so that envelope is taken as the body (read-only inference, no reproduction; the unit doubles answer `undefined`): filed #34560.
